message:
2 speaking attributes carry a string written inline:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:35: title="Delete {{…}} rows"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:37: textContent="{{…}} rows left"
description: Words written around an interpolation in a speaking attribute and in a drawn property, which Angular binds as a property with the text around the expression (measured: the button's `title` and the span's text drawn). Point 3 reads the words as written ones, beside the literals of the expression and apart from point 2's comparison, which holds static attributes and no binding, so the refusal counts two.
